chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Going overseas with Sammy Price and George Wein
summary: He tries to recall whether his first trip to Europe was with Sammy Price or with George Wein's Newport All-Stars, and a solo trip to play in London.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: Yeah. (Inaudible). I even went over the hill with Sammy.
Was that the first time you went?

I think so -- I'm not sure. I'm not sure. It could have been. Could have been the first time. I was going to do the World's Fair. Is that the time? Yeah, that's so. I understand my names up here in the World's Fair and I guess so. I think that was the time.
Well, then I think -- I think you were with the Newport All-Stars from that -- with George.
Yeah, I went with George too. And
Maybe that's the first time I went. You know -- I might have went with George the first time. Then come -- went back again with Sammy.

-- with Sammy. It could have been that way. I don't know. It was in -- well it was in -- I went by myself once over there. To England to play with Terry Wright (PHONETIC), but, you know -- you know, London.
